_about: The site's routing and response headers, written once for any host (see HOSTING.md at the repository root).
node hosting/emit.mjs vercel      writes frontend/vercel.json from this file (a test checks the two match).
node hosting/emit.mjs cloudflare  writes _redirects, _headers and 404 fallbacks into a build (npm run build:cloudflare).
Paths: '*' matches the rest of a path; ':splat' in 'to' puts that part back.
rewrites: serve 'to' when no file exists at 'from' (the address bar keeps 'from').
redirects: send the browser to 'to'; permanent is 308, otherwise 307; 'host' limits a rule to one domain.
headers: added to every response whose path matches.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://accounts.google.com/gsi/style; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://*.googleusercontent.com; media-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://tech-api.katta.cc https://accounts.google.com/gsi/; frame-src https://accounts.google.com/gsi/; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
